step1_analysis.description: A dynamic differential latch or sense amplifier with a clocked tail current source and cross-coupled PMOS load. It evaluates the differential inputs when the clock is high and holds the state dynamically when the clock is low.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f + I_leak * V. With C ~ 50fF, V=1.8V, f=1.6GHz, dynamic power is ~260uW. Short circuit power adds to this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical dynamic power for a latch at 1.6GHz in 130nm.

delay_ck_q.description: Propagation delay from clock rising edge to output Q rising edge

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ~ C * V / I. I ~ 0.5 * un * Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs-Vth)^2 = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * 1.38^2 ~ 2.5mA. Delay ~ 20fF * 0.9V / 2.5mA ~ 7ps. Adding intrinsic delay gives ~20-40ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using first-order RC and current equations for SKY130 parameters.
Cross-coupled PMOS load ensures full swing to VDD.
NMOS switches pull the node to ground when clock is high.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, delay, and voltage swing of the dynamic latch at 1.6GHz clock frequency.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Latch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCK CK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 20p 20p 292.5p 625p)
VD D 0 PULSE(0 1.8 500p 20p 20p 605p 1250p)
VDBAR D_BAR 0 PULSE(1.8 0 500p 20p 20p 605p 1250p)

XM2 Q_BAR D N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 Q Q_BAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM3 Q D_BAR N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 Q_BAR Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N1 CK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

C1 Q 0 10f
C2 Q_BAR 0 10f

.ic v(Q)=0 v(Q_BAR)=1.8 v(N1)=0

.control
tran 5p 3n
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_pwr avg pwr from=0.6n to=3n
meas tran delay_ck_q trig v(CK) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(Q) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran q_max max v(Q) from=0.6n to=3n
meas tran q_min min v(Q) from=0.6n to=3n
print avg_pwr delay_ck_q q_max q_min
quit
.endc
